name: QALS Landing — Night Violet (current)
lineage: current default per themegallery THEMES list ("dark-violet — current default"); superseded the cream classic landing; all 6 theme kits wired in as opt-in switcher
signature: violet energy accent on deep night panels with soft 18px/42px shadows
description: The live qalarc network landing: deep night-blue surfaces with a violet primary, green success and gold/bronze money accents. Deposit of the theme-gallery 'dark-violet' current default; gallery copy at themegallery/landing.html.

name: QALS Landing — Cream Classic (original)
lineage: gallery id "cream-purple" — "THE LIKELY PICK — cream + purple buttons (the old home page)"; parent of the classic theme-kit family; 9AM snapshot is its sibling
signature: cream paper plates, hard 5px 6px 0 #26221a offset shadows, uppercase Archivo buttons
description: The original QALS home page: warm cream paper surfaces with near-black ink, cardinal-red primary buttons, a teal-cyan highlight and gold/bronze ledger tones. Gallery copy includes a theme-kit switcher (landing-kit.html is the same page wired to the kits).

name: QALS Landing — 9AM Snapshot
lineage: gallery id "as-of-9am" — "exactly what the site looked like at 9:00 AM"; same cream family as the original landing, minus the teal highlight; the classic-cardinal kit records this red as "the exact 9AM primary"
description: Point-in-time capture of the cream QALS landing (smaller page, identical cream/cardinal palette). Preserved in the theme gallery as a restoration reference.

name: Classic Purple (qals-classic) — canonical kit
useCases: default theme for crypto site + dashboards
lineage: canonical kit of the style-library; parent of the classic-cardinal/ink/sage variants (generated by scripts/gen_classic_variants.py); default data-theme on hub.html
signature: cream paper + purple accent; tokens + .mat- primitives + shared page bindings
description: The canonical QALS material kit: cream paper background, purple primary, red/coral secondary, gold money tones. Every page in the ui-codex suite ships with this as its default theme.

name: Classic Cardinal kit
lineage: "the exact 9AM primary" — derived from theme-qals-classic.css by scripts/gen_classic_variants.py; selectable in the shipped hub theme picker as "classic · cardinal"
signature: cream plate with cardinal-red primary (the 9AM landing accent)
description: Classic-cardinal variant of the cream kit — the original landing's red primary promoted to a full token kit. One of four generated classic variants.

name: Classic Ink kit
lineage: "mono-dramatic" — derived from theme-qals-classic.css by scripts/gen_classic_variants.py; selectable in hub picker as "classic · ink"
signature: ink-black primary on cream — near-monochrome with red reserved for danger
description: Classic-ink variant: the cream kit drained to a near-monochrome ink-on-paper scheme. Generated classic family member.

name: Classic Sage kit
lineage: "the field-green plate" — derived from theme-qals-classic.css by scripts/gen_classic_variants.py; selectable in hub picker as "classic · sage"
signature: deep sage-green primary on cream
description: Classic-sage variant: the cream kit with a reserved field-green primary. Generated classic family member.

name: Qalarc Cream kit
lineage: one of the original material kits; selectable in the shipped hub picker as "qalarc cream"
signature: warm ivory ground with DM Serif Display headlines and purple ink
description: The qalarc-cream material kit: soft ivory/white surfaces, deep plum text and purple primary, serif display. The most editorial/premium of the light kits.

name: Locker Neobrut kit
lineage: original material kit; selectable in the shipped hub picker as "locker"
signature: brighter cream/white plates with hard offset shadows and chunky cardinal buttons
description: Neubrutalist locker kit: near-white paper cards, thick ink borders, hard drop shadows, red primary. The loud, poster-like end of the kit family.

name: Tradez Heritage kit
lineage: original material kit (shares its identity with the tradez.au site style); selectable in the shipped hub picker as "tradez"
signature: Fraunces serif display over warm paper with forest-green primary
description: Warm paper kit with Fraunces headlines, forest-green primary and terracotta secondary — the tradez.au heritage identity ported into the QALS token system.

name: Gold Ingot kit
lineage: original material kit; offered on the landing theme switcher (not in hub picker)
signature: Anton display type in gold over near-black ink surfaces
description: Dark ingot kit: near-black violet-tinted surfaces, bright gold primary, amber urgency, Anton poster display. The luxury option of the family.

name: Steddi Ember kit
lineage: original material kit; offered on the landing theme switcher (not in hub picker)
signature: warm charcoal-plum surfaces with a red-to-peach ember ramp
description: Steddi kit: dark warm brown-plum surfaces with a full red/coral/peach accent ramp and Sora display. Cozy-dark rather than neon-dark.

name: Techy Terminal kit
lineage: original material kit; offered on the landing theme switcher (not in hub picker)
signature: JetBrains Mono headlines in signal cyan over deep blue-black panels
description: Techy kit: blue-black console surfaces, cyan primary, mint success, mono display type. The instrumentation/terminal flavor of the kit family.

name: QALS Hub Suite (ui-codex)
lineage: interactive suite of the qalarc site; ships on the classic cream base with 7 selectable kits (qals-classic, classic-cardinal/ink/sage, qalarc, locker, tradez); system-map + ticker retain the older night base
signature: 50-card hub grid with hard offset shadows, tabular numerals, faint teal/gold radial glows
description: The self-contained interactive suite: The Hub (50-card navigator), showcase, comparisons, use-cases, PDFs, The Vault (live ledger dashboard), The Loom (chain DAG viewer) and Qalx Boards. All pages share the classic cream token base plus the theme-kit switcher and a floating AI assistant widget.

name: Night Telemetry — System Map + Ticker
lineage: pre-classic night base (#0B0F14 + teal #17E1D5 + gold) — the style the suite carried before the classic-cream conversion; same night family as the QALS Explorer, qalbridge phone UI and Qal Wallet concept
signature: zoomable node map with teal signal lines and gold money highlights on night panels
description: The zoomable system map and activity ticker still run on the original night palette: deep blue-black, signal teal, gold. Preserved inside the otherwise classic-themed ui-codex suite.

name: QALS Explorer
lineage: 6-module explorer whose nodes link into the generated wiki; night palette with green/violet accents (distinct from the teal/gold night of system-map+ticker)
signature: six clickable network modules over a night field with green/violet signal accents
description: The QALS Explorer: a single-file interactive map of the network's six modules (chain, money, chat, markets, identity, ops) in the night palette with Qal-green and violet accents.

name: Qoll Brand Kit
lineage: v1 brand kit (2026-09-06); quoll mascot user-selected; all SVGs generated from scripts/gen_brand.py (source of truth); deployed at qalarc.com/projects/qals/brand/; "approved picks become permanent & protected"
signature: spotted quoll mascot whose spots are coins/ledger entries — "Spotted. Backed."
description: The Qoll brand system: quoll face mark, Q letterforms, one-stroke line mascot, reserve-backed coin faces and a night/cream/bronze/green palette with click-to-copy review page. Rules fix green = confirmed/backed states only.

name: Qal Wallet Concept (Firefly-style)
lineage: concept prototype inside the brand kit (Firefly-style, phone-first); linked from the brand review page and the landing
signature: phone-frame wallet with Qoll guard motif and reserve-backed coin faces
description: The Qal Wallet concept: a phone-first, Firefly-inspired wallet prototype using the brand's night palette with Qal-green confirmations and bronze coin accents.

name: Qal Wallet Desktop UI
lineage: the working wallet-app web UI (archive/ holds v3q/v4q iterations from 2026-09-09); distinct deep-navy palette vs the brand night family
signature: 216px rail / content / 304px side-panel three-column wallet grid with teal-blue duotone accents
description: The Qal Wallet application UI: deep navy surfaces, teal + electric-blue duotone, gold/amber money colors, and a responsive three-column desktop layout guarded by "the Qoll".

name: qalbridge Phone UI
lineage: phone-facing UI of the live qalbridge service (:8837, transcripts + file pulls + approvals); classic night palette
description: Single-file phone UI for the qalbridge agent-to-phone bridge: night background, teal signal accent and gold highlights, system fonts, built for small screens.

name: Qalnet Docs (IOTA design system)
lineage: Docusaurus docs of the private IOTA fork; inherits the IOTA Foundation design system (iota-* tokens, TWK Everett type); tailwind.config.js maps the token set
signature: TWK Everett type with iota-blue/aqua gradient branding on black
description: The qalnet chain documentation site: IOTA's official docs design — black/deep-blue surfaces, iota-blue + neon-aqua accents, TWK Everett display type, full light/dark theming via Docusaurus + Tailwind token bridge.

name: Trading E2E Demo dApp
lineage: IOTA create-dapp scaffold (React + Vite + Tailwind + Radix themes + @iota/dapp-kit); Escrow + Locked dashboards; ships dark-theme by default; no custom palette — stock IOTA dApp-kit styling
description: The trading end-to-end demo dApp: escrow/locked-balance dashboards over IOTA, rendered with the stock dark dApp-kit component styling rather than a bespoke visual identity.

name: Trading Research Desktop v2
lineage: PyQt6 desktop app (v2) with its own app/theme.py token module (BG/PANEL/CYAN/…, MetricCard/ReadBar/Chart widgets); sibling CLI tools dashboard.py + tui.py predate it
signature: near-black violet-tinted panels lit by neon cyan/green metric cards and matplotlib regime charts
description: PyQt6 trading research workbench: void-black panels, neon cyan/green data accents, a full rainbow of strategy/regime colors, matplotlib charts embedded in a dense multi-tab research layout.

name: Trading System TUI
lineage: interactive terminal front-end of the adaptive multi-strategy system; dashboard.py is its menu-driven CLI sibling (ANSI green/red colour codes)
signature: ANSI green/red signal colouring in plain-terminal tables
description: Full-featured terminal UI for the trading system: live market snapshots, backtests, regime analysis and a bot fleet, coloured only by classic green-up/red-down ANSI codes.

name: Lunar Terminal (Stock Terminal)
lineage: Electron + Vite React app launched via Mac-app/Lunar Terminal scripts; layered styles: index.css (deep-space) + phase2 + lunar.css (star-field glow) + hud.css (tactical HUD) all load together
signature: tactical HUD layer: angular brackets, arc segments, circular reticles and dot arrays over a star-field indigo void with lunar cyan
description: The Lunar/Stock Terminal: a deep-space indigo trading cockpit — lunar-cyan data, silver starlight text, glassy panels — overlaid with a monochrome tactical HUD of hairlines, brackets and reticles on near-black.

name: Trading Intelligence Terminal
lineage: vanilla-JS frontend (lightweight-charts) of the Rust/Tauri trading app; 20+ sections (dashboard, fleet, models, sentiment, leaderboard…); companion phone PWA is TAF Monitor
signature: JetBrains Mono numerics over stepped slate surfaces with cyan/violet duotone accents
description: The Trading Intelligence Terminal: a build-free vanilla-JS console in a Tauri shell — layered slate panels, cyan/violet accents, TradingView-grade charts and a dense multi-section research layout.

name: TAF Monitor PWA
lineage: read-only phone companion of the Trading Intelligence Terminal (single-file PWA: manifest + service worker, installs to home screen)
signature: card stack (portfolio / signals / accuracy / fleet / alerts) on a shared #0a0e14 void with green/purple/blue per-card accents
description: TAF Monitor: a full-screen phone PWA for observing the trading system — equity sparklines, top signals, accuracy leaderboard and fleet cards in a calm slate-dark card UI.
